g.text: R2 §5 specification mapped to code (green: implemented on a synthetic institution; amber: partial or a model of the function only)
assess_chain: eleven typed stages, six layers
legal.audit: G1–G15, G12/G15 sub-findings, U, taxonomy
contestation and burden manager — model only
simulate: appeal, authority, independence, burden; G11, G1
correction and restoration tracker — model only
simulate: propagation, relief, re-entry; G10, G15B/C
intervention simulator with time-indexed observation — implemented (synthetic)
Not implemented: authorisation by a competent actor; jurisdiction-specific legal sources; real data; independent evaluation (R2 §26).
The software recommends and records; it cannot self-authorise a legal remedy (R2 §18).
